caribbean.headline: Caribbean Winds Increase
caribbean.paragraph: St. Thomas is experiencing 20 kt winds with 4.7 ft wave heights and a 42% rain probability, while Antigua has 16 kt winds. I expect these conditions to impact Eastern Caribbean ports, particularly St. Thomas, with less severe conditions in Antigua.

mediterranean.headline: Mediterranean Conditions: Mykonos
mediterranean.paragraph: Mykonos in the Eastern Mediterranean is the highest-impact location in the Mediterranean this period, with light winds and seas building to 7.0 ft with NW swell at 7s periods. 38% rain probability -- isolated showers possible but conditions remain manageable.
